Coram : ARIJIT PASAYAT*, P. SATHASIVAM
Penal Code, 1860: s.300 Exception 4, s.302 and s.304 Part I- Sudden fight C between accused and deceased - Accused assaulted deceased with axe lying nearby- Wife of deceased intervened and she was a/so given blow with axe on head - Courts below held accused guilty under ss. 302 and 324 -Accused - Held: Considering D factual background, appropriate conviction would be under s. 304 Part-I and not under s. 302 - Conviction altered accordingly. s.302-App/icability of, when single blow given - Held: It E is not rule of universal application that whenever one blow is given, s. 302 is ruled
Decision Date : 04-03-2008 | Case No : CRIMINAL APPEAL No. 438/2008 | Disposal Nature : Case Partly allowed | Bench : 2 Judges
